statement: Remove or clear content in metaball editing with "Delete"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.
Copy content in metaball editing with "Duplicate Metaball Elements"; the copy has the same values as its source, the source is unchanged, and one undo step removes the copy.
Copy content in metaball editing with "Duplicate"; the copy has the same values as its source, the source is unchanged, and one undo step removes the copy.

Switch visibility, lock, mute or expansion state in metaball editing with "Hide Selected"; the changed state is visible in the UI and the output, it is saved with the document, and one undo step restores it.

Switch visibility, lock, mute or expansion state in metaball editing with "Reveal Hidden"; the changed state is visible in the UI and the output, it is saved with the document, and one undo step restores it.
Change what is selected in metaball editing with "(De)select All"; the new selection is what the next edit command acts on, no data is modified, and one undo step restores the previous selection.
Change what is selected in metaball editing with "Select Random"; the new selection is what the next edit command acts on, no data is modified, and one undo step restores the previous selection.
Change what is selected in metaball editing with "Select Similar"; the new selection is what the next edit command acts on, no data is modified, and one undo step restores the previous selection.
